title: SAM fingerprint forensics + inheritance
harshest_rejection: Fingerprint classifier detects dataset dialect (cf. 0312), not SAM style; prevalence survey and inheritance measurement inherit the confound.
killer_experiment: Controlled-provenance corpus: same images, same annotators, hand-drawn vs SAM-assisted (edit-depth logged) vs raw SAM; require cross-dataset fingerprint generalization with dataset identity controlled; inheritance via matched training on provenance-only-differing labels.
notes: Fresh searches (2) again found no direct competitor; still the data-genetics flagship but must not be greenlit without the dialect control.

title: Stuff-stuff transition-band atlas + band-aware evaluation
harshest_rejection: Boundary IoU with class-pair-specific tolerance is the trivial alternative; near-chance in-band agreement is folklore confirmation; rank flips may be within reproduction noise; BA-ECE (arXiv:2506.16589) and boundary-band losses already use distance bands.
killer_experiment: Multi-rater band atlas on Cityscapes/ADE with fixed interface; band-aware re-scoring with bootstrap CIs on rank changes; mandatory per-pair-d Boundary IoU baseline.
notes: Band width is scale- and interface-indexed (collides with 0150); band-vs-edge classifier must avoid circularity.

title: Boundary GT is scale-relative
harshest_rejection: Broader distributions at low zoom are a mathematical necessity; the only novel claim is the SIGNED shift, and zoom confounds with brush radius, cursor gain, resampling kernel, monitor PSF (task-configuration effects already shown, Bauchwitz WACV 2025).
killer_experiment: Within-annotator randomized zoom-order psychophysics with interface controls incl. integer-scaling resampling control; fund the training-consequence leg only if signed shift/noise > 0.5.
notes: If shifts are directionally inconsistent across annotators there is no bias field, only variance inflation - a weaker paper.

title: Three-way boundary error budget (model/annotation/metric)
harshest_rejection: Decomposition not identifiable: 'annotation share' conflates measurement noise with genuine band ambiguity (own team's 0163); estimator validity asserted, never tested; 200-object extrapolation.
killer_experiment: Validate estimator on synthetic renders with exact vector GT + injected calibrated annotation noise and rasterization variants; then stratified application to real benchmarks with CIs.
notes: Must define whether annotation share means noise-around-curve or band-width; coordinate with 0163/0150 if shipped from one lab.

title: Consensus fusion erases correct minority-expert detections
harshest_rejection: 'Above chance' is a trivial bar (chance near zero); outcome-verified cohorts are selection-biased toward suspicious cases; modern locally-reliability-weighted fusion (RaLMPH arXiv:2606.15554, CASC-AI arXiv:2502.07302) makes global-STAPLE a strawman.
killer_experiment: LIDC-IDRI-anchored pilot: minority-only region precision vs matched random-region control, stratified by subtlety, pre-registered clinically-meaningful effect size; test whether modern fusion still erases those regions.
notes: Region-level outcome linkage is the feasibility crux; if only patient-level outcomes exist the claim dilutes.

title: Findability bias: COD datasets contain only failed camouflage
harshest_rejection: GPS-collar design cannot distinguish successful camouflage from physical occlusion ('in frustum' != 'visible in principle'); ecology has modeled imperfect detection for decades; correction does not transfer to internet-photo COD benchmarks.
killer_experiment: Temporal-adjacency verification in burst/video camera-trap archives: animal visibly identifiable at t+/-k but hard at t; measure human+model recall on t frames; claim a bound, not a benchmark correction.
notes: Mutation removes the ecology-collaboration wall; scope shrinks from 'asterisk on every COD number' to existence proof + bound.

title: Mirror-geometry-verified phantom objects in puddles
freshness_citations: USENIX VehicleSec 2026 'Seeing is Deceiving' (mirror-induced LiDAR phantom objects, end-to-end)
US Patents 12481025 / 12099123 (puddle mirror-image handling)
arXiv:2310.00944 (road-spray ghost objects)
harshest_rejection: The phenomenon is known and engineered around on the LiDAR side (VehicleSec 2026 formalizes phantom Object Addition; patents invert mirror points about the road plane); camera-side rates may be near zero in modern models - null-result trap; planar-mirror verifier fails on rippled puddles.
killer_experiment: One-week pilot: 5 models on ACDC-rain/BDD-rainy/nuImages-rain, mirror test with uncertainty band, 200 hand-verified flags, pre-registered phantom-rate floor; fund full audit only if floor exceeded.
notes: Retire the 'hidden error class' rhetoric; the measurement, not the phenomenon, is missing.

title: Reference-quality asymmetry inflates measured domain gaps
freshness_citations: arXiv:2608.24486 'Model Effect or Label Effect?' (re-annotation shifts DSC 0.14-0.19 vs 0.03 model effect)
arXiv:2509.15107 (chest radiography label quality + domain shift audit)
harshest_rejection: Label-vs-model effect now demonstrated; the quality-vs-convention distinction is not identifiable, and the model-consensus diagnostic detects convention difference and books it as quality.
killer_experiment: Only as merged 0237+0249 three-way decomposition; quality operationalized as within-protocol error adjudicated by target-protocol-trained raters.
notes: Standalone 0249 is un-identifiable and half-scooped; merge mandatory.

title: Annotation-convention shift masquerades as domain shift
freshness_citations: doi:10.63317/3fss6oc5mono 'Annotation Matters' (re-annotation under source protocol recovers up to +39.8 points of cross-corpus gap, NLP)
arXiv:2506.04737 'Bridging Annotation Gaps' (detection label-space/style alignment)
harshest_rejection: The exact re-annotation recipe is published in NLP with dramatic numbers; conceptual novelty spent; convention fraction absorbs quality fraction (identifiability tangle with 0249); UDA-credit claim never tested directly.
killer_experiment: Merged design: convention arm (source-protocol re-annotation) + quality arm (within-protocol adjudication) + evaluate source and UDA-adapted models against all three references; test whether UDA gains concentrate in the convention share.
notes: Merge with 0249; cite the NLP result as template; segmentation-specific three-way decomposition + UDA-credit smoking gun is the surviving paper.

title: Human boundary conventions encode function, not photometry
harshest_rejection: Premise contradicts supervised learning: models are trained on human-annotated labels embodying the functional conventions, so systematic model-vs-human divergence should be ~0 in-distribution; 'human convention' as measured is written-protocol sociology; Hoffman-Richards curvature minima confound function.
killer_experiment: Convention-learnability reframing: signed offset between model outputs and their own training labels per junction type; scaling with local photometric evidence strength; free-labeling human arm to separate protocol from psychology; curvature/function dissociation control.
notes: Still among the deepest ideas after mutation; as written it dies to the training-labels observation.

title: Volume CIs anti-conservative under boundary-correlated errors
freshness_citations: arXiv:2509.22240 COMPASS (conformal intervals directly for segmentation-derived metrics)
arXiv:2505.14113 CONSIGN (spatial-correlation-aware conformal segmentation)
arXiv:2502.21158 CONSeg
arXiv:2410.03406 (conformal confidence sets)
harshest_rejection: The field has routed around the problem via metric-space conformal; nobody defends pixel-independent propagation - name a deployed pipeline or the 2-5x factor is about a strawman; under- vs over-coverage direction differs by pipeline type.
killer_experiment: Deployed-pipeline survey (who actually propagates what) + coverage audit on synthetic-GT lesions separately for variance-propagation and pixelwise-conformal pipelines + correlation-length regression; COMPASS/CONSeg as reference bounds.
notes: F's mutation stands but narrower: the strawman-proofing survey is now mandatory and is itself a contribution.

title: Dice per-instance gradient starvation
freshness_citations: arXiv:2511.17146 CC-DiceCE (ISBI 2026; benchmarks instance losses in nnU-Net and contrasts per-component gradient fields)
harshest_rejection: blob loss owns the phenomenon, gradient analyses exist, and instance-loss papers now include gradient-field contrasts; starvation correlates with size by construction - must beat the size-only predictor; the data-side fix is nnU-Net folklore.
killer_experiment: Instrumented training on 2 multi-lesion 2D datasets; recall ~ starvation + size + contrast + location with pre-registered partial-effect threshold; intervention on gradient allocation at fixed data; test whether blob/CC-DiceCE equalize gradient shares or only outcomes.
notes: Freshness-fragile: six months more of instance-loss-with-gradient-figures papers could flip to KILL; pursue first if pursued.

title: Ensemble-gain collapse by cohort era
freshness_citations: arXiv:2603.17111 Hidden Clones (family-correlated errors collapse 17 VLMs to 2.5-3.6 effective voters)
harshest_rejection: Correlated-error ensembles now demonstrated in vision-language, not just LLMs; era confounds with scale, accuracy, data volume, family, and checkpoint survivorship simultaneously; accuracy-matched cross-era dense cohorts barely exist.
killer_experiment: Replace era with lineage: accuracy-matched dense-model zoo, disjoint vs shared training corpora, effective-voter eigen-analysis + pixel-level shared-error maps; longitudinal story demoted to descriptive figure.
notes: The pixel-level shared-error map is the differentiator no VLM/LLM paper has.

title: Which leaderboards crossed their noise floor
freshness_citations: doi:10.1101/2025.04.28.651001 Cellpose-SAM (inter-human agreement is not a performance bound; consensus bound)
arXiv:2604.03313 CardioSAM (markets surpassing inter-expert agreement)
arXiv:2505.04720 False Promises (53% of segmentation papers with >5% false-claim probability)
arXiv:2512.19091 RankInsight
harshest_rejection: Central inference is statistically wrong: pairwise inter-rater Dice is not an upper bound - consensus-matching models legitimately exceed it (Cellpose-SAM argument); harmonizing published inter-rater figures is apples-to-oranges; leaderboard-fragility space is crowded.
killer_experiment: For 2-3 benchmarks with raw multi-rater masks: consensus-referenced ceiling (rater-vs-consensus extrapolated in N), locate SOTA vs THAT, decompose residuals into style-aligned vs anatomy-aligned components.
notes: After the formalism fix the audit is genuinely useful and CardioSAM-style claims give it a news hook.

title: Provenance-level leakage audit of smoke/fire benchmarks
harshest_rejection: Zero methodological novelty (cluster-based video-frame dedup is standardized: IEEE Access 2024 doi:10.1109/access.2024.3383047, arXiv:2511.13944; Ramos ICCVW 2025 did the genre); drop size is dialable via merge threshold; no ranking change = no paper.
killer_experiment: The audit itself with integrity locks: threshold-sweep curves + manual cluster verification per threshold + pre-registered bootstrap ranking-stability test.
notes: Applications/dataset-track paper, not main-track novelty; value is speed and certainty.

title: Context-completion hallucination with dose-response
freshness_citations: arXiv:2506.21546 HalluSegBench (first counterfactual segmentation-hallucination benchmark, 1340 pairs, 281 classes)
arXiv:2602.10425 HII-DPO (scene-conditioned hallucination via counterfactual object removal, co-occurrence priors)
arXiv:2505.19474 Causal-LLaVA
arXiv:2505.21547 Image Tokens Matter
harshest_rejection: The framing is taken: segmentation hallucination is benchmarked, scene-conditioned hallucination named, co-occurrence mechanism traced; curation-based design is causally weaker than published counterfactual editing.
killer_experiment: Dose-response law on classical segmenters with fully-known training data: mined association strengths vs hallucination rates, edited counterfactuals + real-scene validation, evidence-ablation leg; positioned as the dense/classical complement to HalluSegBench.
notes: Largest freshness casualty in the batch; drops out of top tier as a PhD-year bet; survives as a well-scoped instrument paper.

title: Protocol choice dominates architecture improvement
freshness_citations: Bauchwitz et al. WACV 2025 (task configuration -> annotation quality AND trained-model performance)
doi:10.1038/s42256-023-00625-5 Labelling instructions matter (Nat. Mach. Intell. 2023)
arXiv:2608.24486 Model Effect or Label Effect (label effect ~5x model effect)
harshest_rejection: Every component of the headline now has a published demonstration; five-figure annotation budget for a confirmation-shaped result; 'median architecture improvement' yardstick is curatable; test-set neutrality is impossible without dual-protocol TEST labels.
killer_experiment: Zero-budget mutation: train matched models on COCO vs Sama-COCO (arXiv:2311.02709) label sets of the same images; evaluate on both test references + out-of-family data; compare deltas vs a pre-registered mined distribution of published architecture gains (reuse 0322).
notes: Commissioned-corpus version dead on cost-benefit; Sama-COCO version is a GPU-week study.

title: Topology lost at checkpoint-selection time
harshest_rejection: Betti estimates on val sets are noisy - dominance may be selection on noise; EMA/modern schedules may erase the divergence; fix is a one-liner ('engineering').
killer_experiment: Multi-seed multi-architecture full-checkpoint logging with train/val/test topology trajectories and selection-noise control; either outcome teaches.
notes: Fresh searches found only new topology losses (TopoSculpt arXiv:2509.03938, SDF-TopoNet arXiv:2503.14523, AC2RUNet arXiv:2606.12319) - the field keeps paying training-time costs for a possibly selection-time loss, which IS the idea's point. Cheapest unclaimed decisive result of all 23.

title: Segmentation-free scalar measurement
harshest_rejection: In-domain head-to-head exists and regression LOST (fetal head circumference, PMC8877769; direct cardiac volume 20+ years old, arXiv:1510.06375); supervision-budget circularity (scalar GT derives from masks); the referee vanishes exactly where wins are predicted (high ambiguity = uncertain scalar GT).
killer_experiment: Physical-GT anchoring: phantom/ex-vivo volumes by displacement or manufactured geometry, biomass by harvest weight, cell counts by flow cytometry; vary boundary ambiguity while physical referent stays exact; FHC result as baseline to beat.
notes: F's mutation (exclude counting, pre-register interaction) necessary but not sufficient; physical GT is the survival condition.

title: Signed context-value curves (region vs boundary)
harshest_rejection: 'Decade of monotonicity dogma' is a strawman: HRNet, bilateral nets (BEVANet arXiv:2508.07300), Swin windows already embody locality; CRISP (arXiv:2608.23746) derives boundary over-smoothing from large-RF aggregation mechanistically; retraining arm is weeks not 'a week'.
killer_experiment: F's masked-radius sweep + retrained variants, PLUS locality-embodying architectures as natural experiments on the predicted curve; pre-registered crossover-scale invariance test.
notes: Paper = measured crossover law + architectural cross-validation; drop the dogma framing; boundary metrics must coordinate with C07 noise-floor work.

title: Physical calibration-shape ground truth benchmark
harshest_rejection: After PSF/defocus the image-plane 'true boundary' is a convention (50% crossing vs geometric projection) differing by exactly the sub-pixel amounts claimed - conventionality re-enters at sub-pixel scale; printed shapes are trivially easy stimuli; if biases are below annotation noise, name a downstream decision they change.
killer_experiment: Pilot with full GT error budget (registration + optics + edge-definition-convention sensitivity); viable only if model systematic biases >> GT error budget (publish the inequality as Table 1); one consequence demonstration (a published sub-3px claim reversing under physical GT).
notes: No prior segmentation-metrology benchmark found in fresh searches (calibration-target literature serves geometry: arXiv:2608.05066, arXiv:2307.01013); instrument unclaimed but the optics-convention problem must be solved on paper before printing.

title: Class-agnostic masks leak semantics
freshness_citations: arXiv:2604.10528 BareBones (silhouette-only recognition benchmark over six datasets, 26 VLMs, Texture Bias Cliff)
harshest_rejection: The mask-only recognition instrument now exists and found the OPPOSITE headline for VLMs (collapse without texture); trained-classifier version lands in 30-year-old silhouette recognition; privacy leg is a strawman unless real mask-only release practices are documented.
killer_experiment: (1) Documented-practice survey of mask-only releases with implicit anonymity claims; (2) attack those formats: scene/activity/sensitive-attribute recovery from mask ensembles vs quality; (3) single-object shape->category cited as known baseline.
notes: Only the documented-practice privacy audit survives, conditional on such practices existing.

title: Masklet drift predictable from frame-0 ambiguity
harshest_rejection: Online drift monitors (object-pointer EMA) dominate the pre-flight predictor practically; long-video drift is event-dominated (occlusions/switches) which frame-0 cannot see; memory-design line (arXiv:2512.22624) keeps attributing failure to memory artifacts.
killer_experiment: Variance decomposition of per-object degradation into smooth slope vs discrete events, regressed on frame-0 ambiguity vs motion/occlusion covariates, on vanilla AND memory-fixed SAM2 (DAVIS+MOSE+LVOS).
notes: Reframe from 'static predicts temporal' to 'causal map of where VOS failure comes from'; triage becomes a corollary.
